data.name: MaskReminder
data.abstract: Dataset of "Mask Wearing Status Estimation with Smartwatches"

intro_paper.title: Mask Wearing Status Estimation with Smartwatches
intro_paper.authors: Huina Meng, Xilei Wu, Xin Wang, Yu Fan, Jingang Shi, Han Ding, Fei Wang

additional_info.purpose: We present MaskReminder, an automatic mask-wearing status estimation system based on smartwatches, to remind users who may be exposed to the COVID-19 virus transmission scenarios, to wear a mask.
additional_info.instances_represent: every instance is a time series of different mask-related hand movements actions
additional_info.recommended_data_splits: based on different needs, can split data into training-set/validation-set/testing-set
